messages:
elaine: Heads-up — hit a duplicate job creation in the sampleapp when a streaming request got a 429 during token refresh. Repro steps below, filing because I think it's an SDK parity + idempotency gap. (root ts 1777765432)

sam: Can you paste the minimal repro steps and any logs? trying to figure out if this is a runtime fallback or client replay issue.

elaine: repro: 1) start streaming generation to create a job (POST /jobs) w/ ephemeral token. 2) force token refresh mid-stream (simulate 401->refresh). 3) upstream returns 429 for resume, client retries the last fragment and server ends up creating the job twice. Logs show two distinct POSTs within ~300ms but both with identical payload.

Logs snippet:
```
[2026-03-10T14:12:10Z] client: resume-stream attempt=1
[2026-03-10T14:12:10Z] client: outgoing POST /jobs body={...}
[2026-03-10T14:12:10Z] server: 429 throttle for resume
[2026-03-10T14:12:10Z] client: retrying resume (no idempotency header set)
[2026-03-10T14:12:10Z] server: 201 created job id=J-abc123
[2026-03-10T14:12:10Z] server: 201 created job id=J-def456
```

mike: This looks like the classic delayed-ack + optimistic replay combo. If the SDK automatically retries/resumes without adding an Idempotency-Key and the server's create endpoint isn't checking, you'll get duplicates. We should treat resume/retry as non-idempotent by default unless a deterministic idempotency token is present.

jen: FWIW Node SDK currently replays the last chunk on 429 for streaming. Python SDK attaches an `Idempotency-Key` header in the higher-level job helpers. So parity issue — Node needs the same default or at least an explicit opt-in. Also Node's backoff lacks jitter right now which amplifies thundering duplicates under bursts.

sam: Proposed short-term fix: 1) Add automatic `Idempotency-Key` header for create-like endpoints in both SDKs when using resumable streaming or when `retry_on_429` is enabled. 2) Add small randomized jitter to backoff (e.g., uniform +/- 0.2*base) for 429/5xx retries. 3) Document opt-out and provide `idempotency_key` override in SDK constructors.

sam: Proposed medium-term: sampleapp test that runs token-rotate + forced 429s to assert single-side-effect semantics. Add CI job to catch duplicates.

elaine: Example header snippet we used to validate locally:
`Idempotency-Key: 8b1c6f1a-3f2a-4d0b-a9e2-0f9a4d9c4f1b`

And suggested backoff pseudo: `delay = base * (2 ** n) * (1 + rand(-jitter, +jitter))` where jitter default = 0.15.

mike: Server-side hardening too: check incoming idempotency header + deterministic request fingerprint (method + canonicalized body + resource). Return 409 or the existing resource instead of creating a new one. But we can't rely solely on server changes for immediate PLG users.

devex-bot: test-run: sampleapp/retries/e2e token-rotate suite -> FAILED (duplicate job detected x1). Full logs uploaded to ci.build/6789.

jen: I'll take Node SDK parity PR for the idempotency header + jitter defaults. Will add a flag `disable_auto_idempotency` for customers who depend on previous behaviour.

jen: Questions for reviewers: acceptance criteria? my draft: a) Node attaches `Idempotency-Key` on create endpoints when `retry_on_429` or `resumable_stream` enabled; b) jitter enabled by default (configurable); c) unit tests + integration e2e that reproduce token-rotate + 429 with no duplicates; d) docs + changelog entry.

elaine: +1 on those ACs. Add one more: e) sampleapp default demo should show idempotency header usage and a failing e2e before the fix (so we can prove regression). Also add a short troubleshooting note in the SDK FAQ about when you might want to supply your own idempotency key (webhooks, payments, heavy producers).

sam: I'll file the umbrella task and assign: Node SDK PR to @jen, server-side idempotency checklist to @mike, sampleapp test + CI to @elaine. Can we aim for small PRs landed next week? :calendar: 

elaine: I can add the CI e2e fixture tomorrow and push a failing test so the PRs have a guardrail.

mike: Server checklist in a gist, will link in PR. Also will propose returning existing resource on duplicate create if fingerprint matches.

jen: thanks — will open PR this afternoon and ping for reviews.

sam: Great. TL;DR for RFC: default idempotency header for create-ish ops during resume/retries, add jitter, parity across SDKs, e2e test in sampleapp.

elaine: thanks all — this is higher priority than I thought (customer hit in staging). Please ping if you need logs or sample traces. :pray:
